# Barney Pullen

## Overview

- **Age:** Twenty years old  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>

## Appearance

He is a large, overweight lad with a round face that lacks expression.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_

## Personality

He is an emotionless young man with an agonizing inability to hold a conversation. Shy in social situations, he flees out of sheer dread at the prospect of being invited to join a formal supper. Despite his lack of chatter or laughter, he takes immense pride in accompanying someone he admires.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039)_

## Traits

- Overweight  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- Emotionless  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- Inarticulate  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- Shy  <sub>[v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039)</sub>

## Abilities

- Driving a carriage team  <sub>[v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006)</sub>

## History

Barney drove his sister Odette, along with Nell Harcourt and Isolde Pembroke, in a double-seated buggy to a concert at Pale Sands. During the trip, he demanded that Nell sit beside him on the front seat, feeling immense pride in traveling with her due to his vast admiration for her. Because of his inability to converse, he merely smirked and laughed softly whenever she spoke to him, failing to think of answers until the moment had passed. Upon arriving at the hotel, he fled and could not be located when the girls were invited to supper, as he dreaded receiving an invitation himself. However, he waited faithfully outside with his team until the event concluded to drive the girls back under the moonlight.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029), [v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039)_
